### Paul's Desire to See Timothy
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/pauls-desire-see-timothy
Passage: 2 Timothy 4:9-13
Points:
- Paul experienced deep loneliness in a Roman prison after Demas deserted him and other companions departed for ministry assignments.
- Realizing his time before martyrdom was short, Paul urgently requested that Timothy come visit him soon.
- Even at the end of his life, Paul asked for his cloak for warmth and his scrolls to continue studying God's Word.
- Paul demonstrated that believers need Christian fellowship and should surround themselves with brothers and sisters who offer prayer and support.
